name: Booking slots
oneLiner: a white booking page lands on a warm lit desk: host photo and call type, a strip of days and a grid of time slots; a cursor picks a day, the slots reload, it picks a time and presses Confirm, then the slots fold away and a green confirmed panel rises with the check, the date and the time
say: when the speaker says people book time with them ('they pick a slot and book a call', 'just grab a time on my calendar'): cut in on 'book', the slot is picked on 'pick' and the green panel lands on 'booked' or 'confirmed'
